sentences.zh: 厄魯特蒙古欲得大草灘駐牧，勇用進寶議，持不可。

translations.literal: The Oirat Mongols wished to pasture at Dacaotan; Yong adopted Jinbao's counsel and maintained that it could not be allowed.
translations.idiomatic: The Oirat Mongols sought to pasture at Dacaotan. Zhang Yong took Jinbao's advice and held that it could not be allowed.

sentences.zh: 既，城永固，以進寶為副將駐其地。

translations.literal: Thereafter Yongyuan was fortified, and Jinbao was made deputy regional commander stationed there.
translations.idiomatic: Yongyuan was then fortified, and Jinbao was made deputy regional commander and stationed there.

sentences.zh: 十二年，擢西寧總兵。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he was promoted to Regional Commander of Xining.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he was promoted to regional commander of Xining.

sentences.zh: 王輔臣攻陷蘭州，勇遣進寶率師討之。

translations.literal: Wang Fuchen captured Lanzhou; Yong dispatched Jinbao to lead troops against him.
translations.idiomatic: When Wang Fuchen took Lanzhou, Zhang Yong sent Jinbao to lead troops against him.

sentences.zh: 次黃河，夜以革囊結筏自蔡灣渡，破賊皋蘭龍尾山，獲輔臣將李廷玉。

translations.literal: Halting at the Yellow River, by night they bound rafts of leather bags and crossed from Caiban Bay, broke the rebels at Longwei Mountain in Gaolan, and captured Fuchen's general Li Tingyu.
translations.idiomatic: Halting at the Yellow River, they bound rafts of leather bags by night and crossed from Caiban Bay. They routed the rebels at Longwei Mountain in Gaolan and captured Fuchen's general Li Tingyu.

sentences.zh: 遂東拔安定，復金縣。

translations.literal: Then they seized Anding to the east and recovered Jinxian.
translations.idiomatic: They then took Anding to the east and recovered Jinxian.

sentences.zh: 西攻臨洮，會大雪，詗賊不誡備，襲破之。

translations.literal: Attacking Lintao to the west, they met heavy snow; spies learned the rebels were off guard, and a surprise attack broke them.
translations.idiomatic: Attacking Lintao to the west, they met heavy snow. Spies reported that the rebels were unprepared, and a surprise attack broke them.

sentences.zh: 輔臣使持吳三桂劄招進寶，進寶以聞，加左都督。

translations.literal: Fuchen sent envoys bearing Wu Sangui's letter to recruit Jinbao; Jinbao reported it to the throne and was promoted to Left Regional Commander.
translations.idiomatic: Fuchen sent envoys with Wu Sangui's letter to win Jinbao over. Jinbao reported it to the throne and was promoted to Left Regional Commander.

sentences.zh: 四月，進攻蘭州。

translations.literal: In the fourth month they advanced to attack Lanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month they advanced to attack Lanzhou.

sentences.zh: 輔臣遣兵開壁出戰，進寶督兵奮擊，自旦至日中，擒斬過半。

translations.literal: Fuchen sent troops to open the walls and give battle; Jinbao directed his men in fierce assault from dawn to midday, capturing and killing more than half.
translations.idiomatic: Fuchen sent troops out to give battle. Jinbao directed a fierce assault from dawn to midday, capturing and killing more than half the enemy.

sentences.zh: 賊敗入壁，為長圍困之，斷其糧運。

translations.literal: The rebels defeated retreated into the walls; he made a long encirclement to besiege them and cut their grain supply.
translations.idiomatic: The defeated rebels withdrew behind the walls. He laid a long encirclement, besieged the city, and cut off its grain supply.

sentences.zh: 六月，輔臣兵造筏黃河，謀潛遁。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Fuchen's troops built rafts on the Yellow River, intending to slip away in secret.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Fuchen's troops built rafts on the Yellow River, planning to slip away in secret.

sentences.zh: 進寶緣河要之，賊計蹙，其將趙士升出降。

translations.literal: Jinbao blocked them along the river; the rebels' plan was cramped, and their general Zhao Shisheng came out to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Jinbao blocked them along the river. With their plan thwarted, their general Zhao Shisheng came out to surrender.

sentences.zh: 其秋，三桂遣其將王屏籓、吳之茂自四川入陝西，為輔臣聲援。

translations.literal: That autumn Sangui sent his generals Wang Pingfan and Wu Zhimao from Sichuan into Shaanxi to support Fuchen.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn Wu Sangui sent his generals Wang Pingfan and Wu Zhimao from Sichuan into Shaanxi to support Fuchen.

sentences.zh: 之茂據西和鳳凰山，進寶督兵討之，初合，我師敗績；

translations.literal: Zhimao held Fenghuang Mountain in Xihe; Jinbao directed troops against him; on first contact our army was defeated;
translations.idiomatic: Zhimao held Fenghuang Mountain in Xihe. Jinbao led troops against him, but on first contact our army was defeated;

sentences.zh: 夜，之茂兵來襲，進寶以計環攻之，蹙之黨家山，大潰，多墜崖死。

translations.literal: at night Zhimao's troops came to attack; Jinbao by stratagem surrounded them, drove them in distress to Dangjia Mountain, and they broke utterly—many fell from cliffs to their death.
translations.idiomatic: that night Zhimao's troops attacked again. Jinbao by stratagem surrounded them, drove them in distress to Dangjia Mountain, and they broke utterly—many fell from the cliffs to their death.

sentences.zh: 十五年，擢陝西提督，仍兼領西寧總兵，駐秦州。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he was promoted to Shaanxi Provincial Military Commissioner, still concurrently commanding Xining, stationed at Qinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he was promoted to Shaanxi provincial military commissioner, still concurrently commanding Xining, and stationed at Qinzhou.

sentences.zh: 之茂進據北山，斷臨洮、鞏昌道。

translations.literal: Zhimao advanced to hold Beishan and cut the routes to Lintao and Gongchang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhimao advanced to hold Beishan and cut the routes to Lintao and Gongchang.

sentences.zh: 進寶與將軍佛尼埒分兵赴援，擊敗之，獲其將徐大仁。

translations.literal: Jinbao and General Funiye divided forces to relieve them, defeated the enemy, and captured their general Xu Daren.
translations.idiomatic: Jinbao and General Funiye divided their forces to relieve them, defeated the enemy, and captured their general Xu Daren.

sentences.zh: 戰羅家堡，再戰鹽關，屢勝。

translations.literal: They fought at Luojia Fort and again at Yanguan Pass, winning repeatedly.
translations.idiomatic: They fought at Luojia Fort and again at Yanguan Pass, winning repeatedly.

sentences.zh: 之茂集潰兵萬餘屯鐵葉硤、紅山堡，築壘，護以密椿，潛出運芻糧。

translations.literal: Zhimao gathered more than ten thousand fugitive troops at Tiejia Gorge and Hongshan Fort, built stockades, protected them with dense stakes, and secretly sent men out to transport fodder and grain.
translations.idiomatic: Zhimao gathered more than ten thousand fugitive troops at Tiejia Gorge and Hongshan Fort, built stockades behind dense stakes, and secretly sent men out to haul fodder and grain.

sentences.zh: 進寶遣兵破賊牡丹園，獲糧械。

translations.literal: Jinbao sent troops to break the rebels at Mudan Garden and seized grain and weapons.
translations.idiomatic: Jinbao sent troops to break the rebels at Mudan Garden and seized their grain and weapons.

sentences.zh: 大將軍圖海進攻平涼，輔臣引四川叛將譚弘犯通渭。

translations.literal: Grand General Tu Hai advanced to attack Pingliang; Fuchen led the Sichuan rebel general Tan Hong to invade Tongwei.
translations.idiomatic: Grand General Tu Hai advanced on Pingliang. Fuchen led the Sichuan rebel general Tan Hong to invade Tongwei.

sentences.zh: 進寶引數十騎入自東峽口，聞將軍赫葉戰敗，寇方張，令諸軍伐木曳以行，塵大起，寇駭走，追殺數十里。

translations.literal: Jinbao led several dozen horsemen in by the eastern pass, heard that General Heye had been defeated and the bandits were spreading; he ordered the armies to fell trees and drag them as they marched, raising great dust; the bandits fled in alarm, and they pursued and slaughtered for several tens of li.
translations.idiomatic: Jinbao led several dozen horsemen in through the eastern pass. Hearing that General Heye had been defeated and the enemy was spreading, he ordered his troops to fell trees and drag them along as they marched, raising a great dust cloud. The enemy fled in alarm, and they pursued and killed them for several tens of li.

sentences.zh: 分兵進攻，復靜寧，於是平涼遂下。

translations.literal: Dividing forces to advance the attack, they recovered Jingning; Pingliang was then taken.
translations.idiomatic: Dividing his forces to press the attack, he recovered Jingning, and Pingliang then fell.

sentences.zh: 六月，師次樂門，甫立營，之茂兵來攻，進寶督兵環擊，殲其裨將數輩。

translations.literal: In the sixth month the army halted at Lemen; they had just encamped when Zhimao's troops attacked; Jinbao directed encircling assault and killed several of their subordinate generals.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month the army halted at Lemen. They had barely pitched camp when Zhimao's troops attacked. Jinbao directed an encircling assault and killed several of their subordinate generals.

sentences.zh: 復與佛尼埒合兵，戰屢勝，之茂僅以十餘騎潰走。

translations.literal: Again joining Funiye, they fought repeatedly and won; Zhimao escaped with only a dozen or so horsemen.
translations.idiomatic: Joining Funiye again, they fought repeatedly and won. Zhimao escaped with only a dozen or so horsemen.

sentences.zh: 平原、固原悉定。

translations.literal: Pingyuan and Guyuan were all pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Pingyuan and Guyuan were all pacified.

sentences.zh: 論功，授二等阿思哈尼哈番。

translations.literal: When achievements were assessed he was granted a second-class ashanihaqan.
translations.idiomatic: When achievements were assessed he was granted a second-class ashanihaqan.

sentences.zh: 上褒進寶忠義，進一等，授奮威將軍，仍兼提督平涼諸軍事。

translations.literal: The Emperor praised Jinbao's loyalty and righteousness, advanced him to first class, appointed him General Who Inspires Awe, and he still concurrently directed the Pingliang forces as provincial military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor praised Jinbao's loyalty and righteousness, advanced him to first class, appointed him General Who Inspires Awe, and left him in command of the Pingliang armies as provincial military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十七年，复慶陽，斬其將袁本秀。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year they recovered Qingyang and beheaded the rebel general Yuan Benxiu.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he recovered Qingyang and beheaded the rebel general Yuan Benxiu.

sentences.zh: 十八年，圖海議取漢中。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year Tu Hai planned to take Hanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year Tu Hai planned to take Hanzhong.

sentences.zh: 圖海與總兵費雅達自棧道先驅，進寶疏乞令長子用予隨徵，上授以副將。

translations.literal: Tu Hai and Regional Commander Fei Yada led the vanguard by the plank road; Jinbao memorialized asking that his eldest son Yongzi accompany the campaign; the Emperor appointed him deputy commander.
translations.idiomatic: Tu Hai and regional commander Fei Yada led the vanguard by the plank road. Jinbao memorialized asking that his eldest son Yongzi join the campaign, and the Emperor appointed Yongzi deputy commander.

sentences.zh: 師進次寶雞，進寶遣用予擊賊紅花鋪，大敗之，克鳳、兩當二縣。

translations.literal: The army advanced and halted at Baoji; Jinbao sent Yongzi to attack the rebels at Honghua Post, routed them heavily, and took Feng and Liangdang counties.
translations.idiomatic: The army advanced to Baoji. Jinbao sent Yongzi to attack the rebels at Honghua Post, routed them heavily, and took Feng and Liangdang counties.

sentences.zh: 復進次武關，令用予將偏師繞出關後，進寶督兵夜斬關入，獲其將羅朝興等。

translations.literal: Advancing again they halted at Wuguan; Jinbao ordered Yongzi to take a detached force around behind the pass while he himself led troops to cut the pass by night, capturing their generals Luo Chaoxing and others.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing again they halted at Wuguan. Jinbao ordered Yongzi to take a detached force around behind the pass while he himself led troops to storm the pass by night, capturing their generals Luo Chaoxing and others.

sentences.zh: 復進奪雞頭關，直趨漢中，屏籓率其眾自青石關走廣元，進寶遣兵追擊，其將楊永祚、孫啟耀來降，遂盡复漢中地。

translations.literal: Advancing again they seized Jitou Pass and pressed straight on Hanzhong; Pingfan led his mass from Qingstone Pass toward Guangyuan; Jinbao sent troops in pursuit; his generals Yang Yongzuo and Sun Qiyao came to surrender, and Hanzhong territory was wholly recovered.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing again they seized Jitou Pass and pressed straight on Hanzhong. Pingfan led his forces from Qingstone Pass toward Guangyuan. Jinbao sent troops in pursuit. His generals Yang Yongzuo and Sun Qiyao surrendered, and Hanzhong was wholly recovered.

sentences.zh: 時趙良棟亦克略陽，命分道定四川。

translations.literal: At that time Zhao Liangdong also took Lüeyang; they were ordered to pacify Sichuan by separate routes.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Zhao Liangdong also took Lüeyang. They were ordered to pacify Sichuan by separate routes.

sentences.zh: 將軍吳丹、鄂克濟哈率滿洲兵繼進，進寶自青石關進次神宣驛，督兵奪朝天關，疾馳進，拔廣元。

translations.literal: Generals Wu Dan and Ekejieha led Manchu troops in follow-up; Jinbao from Qingstone Pass advanced to Shenxuan Post, directed the taking of Chaotian Pass, galloped forward, and seized Guangyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Generals Wu Dan and Ekejieha led Manchu troops in support. Jinbao advanced from Qingstone Pass to Shenxuan Post, directed the capture of Chaotian Pass, galloped forward, and took Guangyuan.

sentences.zh: 屏籓走保寧。

translations.literal: Pingfan fled to Baoning.
translations.idiomatic: Pingfan fled to Baoning.

sentences.zh: 十九年，分兵趨保寧，距城二十里當孔道立營，屏籓以二萬人出戰，進寶督兵奮擊，大破之。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year they divided forces toward Baoning, encamped twenty li from the city on the main road, Pingfan came out with twenty thousand men to fight, and Jinbao directed fierce assault and routed them utterly.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year they divided forces toward Baoning and encamped twenty li from the city on the main road. Pingfan came out with twenty thousand men to fight. Jinbao directed a fierce assault and routed them utterly.

sentences.zh: 追至錦屏山，連拔賊壘，奪浮橋。

translations.literal: Pursuing to Jinping Mountain they successively took rebel strongpoints and seized the pontoon bridge.
translations.idiomatic: Pursuing to Jinping Mountain, they took rebel strongpoints in succession and seized the pontoon bridge.

sentences.zh: 薄城，守兵貫弓注矢，進寶披襟示之曰：「何不射我？

translations.literal: Pressing the city, the defenders bent their bows and nocked arrows; Jinbao threw open his robe and showed himself, saying: "Why do you not shoot me?
translations.idiomatic: Pressing the city, the defenders bent their bows and nocked arrows. Jinbao threw open his robe and showed himself, saying, "Why do you not shoot me?

sentences.zh: 」守兵皆驚愕。

translations.literal: " The defenders were all startled.
translations.idiomatic: " The defenders were all startled.

sentences.zh: 用予斬門入，進寶戢諸軍毋驚井裡，皆曰：「此仁義將軍也！

translations.literal: Yongzi cut through the gate and entered; Jinbao restrained the armies from disturbing the wards and lanes, and all said: "This is a general of benevolence and righteousness!
translations.idiomatic: Yongzi cut through the gate and entered. Jinbao restrained his troops from disturbing the wards and lanes, and all said, "This is a general of benevolence and righteousness!

sentences.zh: 」屏籓與其將陳君極縊焉，獲之茂與其將張起龍、郭天春等十七人，誅之。

translations.literal: " Pingfan and his general Chen Junji hanged themselves; they captured Zhimao and his generals Zhang Qilong, Guo Tianchun, and seventeen others, and executed them.
translations.idiomatic: " Pingfan and his general Chen Junji hanged themselves. They captured Zhimao and his generals Zhang Qilong, Guo Tianchun, and seventeen others, and executed them.

sentences.zh: 分部諸將及次子用賓复昭化，劍州、蒼溪、蓬州、廣安、合州、西充、岳池諸州縣悉定。

translations.literal: Detaching generals and his second son Yongbin, they recovered Zhaohua; Jianzhou, Cangxi, Pengzhou, Guang'an, Hezhou, Xichong, Yuechi, and other prefectures and counties were all pacified.
translations.idiomatic: He detached his generals and his second son Yongbin to recover Zhaohua. Jianzhou, Cangxi, Pengzhou, Guang'an, Hezhou, Xichong, Yuechi, and other prefectures and counties were all pacified.

sentences.zh: 時良棟已克成都，授雲貴總督，移軍下雲南。

translations.literal: At that time Liangdong had already taken Chengdu, been appointed Governor-General of Yunnan-Guizhou, and moved his army down into Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: By then Liangdong had already taken Chengdu, been appointed governor-general of Yunnan-Guizhou, and moved his army down into Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 詔進寶留鎮四川，駐保寧。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Jinbao to remain to garrison Sichuan, stationed at Baoning.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Jinbao to remain and garrison Sichuan, stationed at Baoning.

sentences.zh: 擢用予松潘總兵。

translations.literal: Yongzi was promoted to Regional Commander of Songpan.
translations.idiomatic: Yongzi was promoted to regional commander of Songpan.

sentences.zh: 進寶疏稱疾乞休，命還固原就醫，即令用予護諸軍駐保寧。

translations.literal: Jinbao memorialized claiming illness and asking to retire; he was ordered back to Guyuan for medical treatment, and Yongzi was immediately ordered to command the armies at Baoning.
translations.idiomatic: Jinbao memorialized claiming illness and asking to retire. He was ordered back to Guyuan for treatment, and Yongzi was immediately ordered to command the armies at Baoning.

sentences.zh: 尋改用予固原總兵。

translations.literal: Soon Yongzi was reassigned Regional Commander of Guyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Yongzi was soon reassigned regional commander of Guyuan.

sentences.zh: 良棟檄川、陝諸軍從征，進寶疏言所屬諸軍宜留鎮守，請停撥遣，從之。

translations.literal: Liangdong issued orders for Sichuan and Shaanxi armies to join the campaign; Jinbao memorialized that the troops under his command ought to remain on garrison duty and asked that requisitions cease; his request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Liangdong ordered the Sichuan and Shaanxi armies to join the campaign. Jinbao memorialized that the troops under his command ought to remain on garrison duty and asked that they not be requisitioned. His request was granted.

sentences.zh: 三桂將胡國柱、夏國相等自貴州入四川，譚弘既降复叛，陷建昌。

translations.literal: Sangui's generals Hu Guozhu and Xia Guoxiang and others entered Sichuan from Guizhou; Tan Hong, who had already surrendered, rebelled again and seized Jianchang.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Sangui's generals Hu Guozhu and Xia Guoxiang and others entered Sichuan from Guizhou. Tan Hong, who had already surrendered, rebelled again and seized Jianchang.

sentences.zh: 良棟疏劾進寶，進寶言方臥疾，固原、建昌之陷，罪在良棟，詔趣進寶還保寧護諸軍。

translations.literal: Liangdong memorialized to impeach Jinbao; Jinbao said he was then bedridden with illness, and that the fall of Guyuan and Jianchang was Liangdong's fault; an edict urged Jinbao to return to Baoning to command the armies.
translations.idiomatic: Liangdong memorialized to impeach Jinbao. Jinbao replied that he was then bedridden, and that the fall of Guyuan and Jianchang was Liangdong's fault. An edict urged Jinbao to return to Baoning to command the armies.

sentences.zh: 敘功，進三等精奇尼哈番，用予加左都督，授拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: When achievements were assessed Jinbao was advanced to third-class jingqi nihaqan; Yongzi was given Left Regional Commander and granted toshala haqan.
translations.idiomatic: When achievements were assessed, Jinbao was advanced to third-class jingqi nihaqan. Yongzi was promoted to Left Regional Commander and granted toshala haqan.

sentences.zh: 二十年，三桂將馬寶犯敘州，用予擊卻之，並復納溪、江安、仁懷、合江諸縣，降其將何德成等，寶竄還雲南。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year Sangui's general Ma Bao invaded Yizhou; Yongzi drove him back and also recovered Naxi, Jiang'an, Renhuai, Hejiang, and other counties, inducing their generals He Decheng and others to surrender; Bao fled back to Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year Wu Sangui's general Ma Bao invaded Yizhou. Yongzi drove him back, recovered Naxi, Jiang'an, Renhuai, Hejiang, and other counties, and induced their generals He Decheng and others to surrender. Bao fled back to Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 上命用予率所部駐永寧。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered Yongzi to lead his command to garrison Yongning.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor ordered Yongzi to lead his command to garrison Yongning.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，雲南平，進寶入覲，良棟亦詣京師，命王大臣發還互劾章奏，並宣諭：「二臣功績並茂，欲矜全保護之；

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year Yunnan was pacified; Jinbao entered audience and Liangdong also came to the capital; a prince-minister was ordered to return their mutual impeachment memorials and proclaim an instruction: "The two ministers' achievements are equally abundant; We wish to show mercy and protect them both;
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year Yunnan was pacified. Jinbao came to court and Liangdong also went to the capital. A prince-minister was ordered to return their mutual impeachment memorials and proclaim: "The achievements of both ministers are abundant alike, and We wish to show mercy and protect them both;

sentences.zh: 私忿攻訐，不諳大體，皆置不問。

translations.literal: their private animosities and mutual attacks show no grasp of the larger interest, and all are set aside without inquiry.
translations.idiomatic: their private animosities and mutual attacks show no grasp of the larger interest, and all are set aside without inquiry.

sentences.zh: 」語互詳良棟傳。

translations.literal: " The words are given in full in Liangdong's biography.
translations.idiomatic: " The full account is given in Liangdong's biography.

sentences.zh: 賚服物，還鎮。

translations.literal: They were bestowed robes and other gifts and returned to their commands.
translations.idiomatic: They were bestowed robes and other gifts and returned to their commands.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，疾甚乞休，時用予已調太原總兵，命偕太醫馳驛視疾。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, gravely ill, he asked to retire; Yongzi had by then been transferred to Regional Commander of Taiyuan; the Emperor ordered him to accompany an imperial physician by urgent relay to attend the illness.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year, gravely ill, he asked to retire. Yongzi had by then been transferred to regional commander of Taiyuan. The Emperor ordered him to accompany an imperial physician by urgent relay to attend his father.

sentences.zh: 尋移甘肅總兵，俾便奉侍。

translations.literal: Soon Yongzi was moved to Regional Commander of Gansu so that he might conveniently tend his father.
translations.idiomatic: Yongzi was soon moved to regional commander of Gansu so that he could conveniently attend his father.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，進寶卒，贈太子太保，賜祭葬，諡忠勇。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year Jinbao died; he was posthumously granted Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, granted sacrificial rites and burial honors, and given the posthumous name Zhongyong.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year Jinbao died. He was posthumously granted Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, granted state funeral honors, and given the posthumous name Zhongyong.

sentences.zh: 用予襲爵，進二等，尋卒官。

translations.literal: Yongzi inherited the rank, which was advanced to second class; he soon died in office.
translations.idiomatic: Yongzi inherited the rank, which was advanced to second class. He soon died in office.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三十三年，命世襲罔替。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year of Qianlong perpetual hereditary succession was ordered.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-third year of Qianlong perpetual hereditary succession was ordered.

sentences.zh: 四十七年，進一等，用賓授侍衛。

translations.literal: In the forty-seventh year the rank was advanced to first class; Yongbin was appointed imperial bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-seventh year the rank was advanced to first class. Yongbin was appointed imperial bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 進寶所部多材武，王萬祥尤著。

translations.literal: Many of Jinbao's subordinates were skilled and martial; Wang Wanxiang was especially notable.
translations.idiomatic: Many of Jinbao's subordinates were skilled fighters; Wang Wanxiang was especially notable.

sentences.zh: 萬祥，字瑞宇，會寧人。

translations.literal: Wanxiang, courtesy name Ruiyu, was a native of Huining.
translations.idiomatic: Wanxiang, courtesy name Ruiyu, was a native of Huining.

sentences.zh: 幼喪父母，依其戚郭氏，從其姓。

translations.literal: Orphaned young of both parents, he depended on his kinsman the Guo clan and took their surname.
translations.idiomatic: Orphaned young of both parents, he was raised by his kinsman the Guo clan and took their surname.

sentences.zh: 進寶官游擊，應募入伍，屢當軍鋒。

translations.literal: When Jinbao was brigade commander, Wanxiang enrolled in the ranks and repeatedly met the army's van.
translations.idiomatic: When Jinbao was brigade commander, Wanxiang enrolled in the ranks and repeatedly took the brunt of battle.

sentences.zh: 積功至副將。

translations.literal: By accumulated merit he rose to deputy regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: By accumulated merit he rose to deputy regional commander.

sentences.zh: 攻蘭州，萬祥請先取臨洮，進寶率兵以夜半至城下。

translations.literal: In the attack on Lanzhou, Wanxiang urged taking Lintao first; Jinbao led troops to the foot of the wall at midnight.
translations.idiomatic: In the attack on Lanzhou, Wanxiang urged taking Lintao first. Jinbao led troops to the foot of the wall at midnight.

sentences.zh: 萬祥見城有缺，令裨將閻潤先登，縋萬祥上，數十人從，守者驚覺，發矢石。

translations.literal: Wanxiang saw a breach in the wall, ordered subordinate commander Yan Run to ascend first, hauled Wanxiang up, and several dozen men followed; the defenders awoke in alarm and discharged arrows and stones.
translations.idiomatic: Wanxiang saw a breach in the wall and ordered subordinate commander Yan Run to ascend first. They hauled Wanxiang up, and several dozen men followed. The defenders awoke in alarm and rained down arrows and stones.

sentences.zh: 萬祥語眾曰：「今欲退無路，惟有猛進！

translations.literal: Wanxiang said to the men: "Now if we wish to retreat there is no road; we can only press forward with all our might!
translations.idiomatic: Wanxiang said to the men, "If we retreat now there is no way out. We can only press forward with all our might!

sentences.zh: 」手刃數人，眾繼上，遂克臨洮。

translations.literal: " He killed several men with his own hand; the rest followed up, and Lintao was taken.
translations.idiomatic: " He killed several men with his own hand. The rest followed, and Lintao was taken.

sentences.zh: 寧夏兵變，軍中流言洶洶，萬祥告進寶。

translations.literal: When Ningxia troops mutinied, rumors ran wild through the army; Wanxiang informed Jinbao.
translations.idiomatic: When Ningxia troops mutinied, rumors ran wild through the army. Wanxiang informed Jinbao.

sentences.zh: 翌日，陽引兵退，而置伏以待。

translations.literal: The next day, openly feigning retreat, he led troops back while setting ambushes to wait.
translations.idiomatic: The next day he feigned withdrawal, led his troops back, and set ambushes to wait.

sentences.zh: 敵來追，伏起，敵大敗。

translations.literal: The enemy came in pursuit; the ambush rose, and the enemy suffered a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: When the enemy pursued, the ambush struck and they were routed.

sentences.zh: 俄，至者益眾，萬祥中矢，手拔，戰益奮，左輔又創，仍力戰，敵乃潰奔，克通渭。

translations.literal: Soon those arriving grew ever more numerous; Wanxiang was struck by an arrow, pulled it out by hand, and fought all the more fiercely; the left wing was wounded again, yet he still fought with force; the enemy then broke and fled, and Tongwei was taken.
translations.idiomatic: Soon reinforcements swelled. Wanxiang took an arrow, pulled it out by hand, and fought all the harder; the left wing was hit again, yet he pressed on until the enemy broke and fled and Tongwei was taken.

sentences.zh: 進寶憤城人通賊，將悉按誅之，萬祥諫而止。

translations.literal: Jinbao was enraged that townspeople were communicating with the rebels and was about to punish them all according to law; Wanxiang remonstrated and stopped it.
translations.idiomatic: Jinbao was furious that locals had aided the rebels and was about to execute them all; Wanxiang dissuaded him and the punishment was halted.

sentences.zh: 攻漢中，將二千四百人斷敵運道，敵棄寨，屯八角原，復攻之下。

translations.literal: In the attack on Hanzhong, with twenty-four hundred men he cut the enemy supply route; the enemy abandoned their stockade and encamped at Bajiao Plain; he attacked again and took it.
translations.idiomatic: Attacking Hanzhong, he led twenty-four hundred men to sever the enemy supply line. The enemy abandoned their camp and held Bajiao Plain; he attacked again and captured it.

sentences.zh: 土寇起，擊斬其渠。

translations.literal: Local bandits rose; he attacked and beheaded their leader.
translations.idiomatic: When local bandits rose, he attacked and beheaded their leader.

sentences.zh: 拔鳳縣，分兵取兩當。

translations.literal: He took Feng County and detached troops to seize Liangdang.
translations.idiomatic: He captured Feng County and sent detachments to take Liangdang.

sentences.zh: 雪夜進攻武關，擒其將劉哈性。

translations.literal: On a snowy night he advanced to attack Wuguan and captured the enemy general Liu Haxing.
translations.idiomatic: On a snowy night he stormed Wuguan and captured the rebel general Liu Haxing.

sentences.zh: 戰閻王碥，用予陷圍中，萬祥馳援，傷右股，還固原療治。

translations.literal: Fighting at Yanwang Ridge, Yongzi was trapped in encirclement; Wanxiang galloped to the rescue, was wounded in the right thigh, and returned to Guyuan for treatment.
translations.idiomatic: At Yanwang Ridge, Yongzi was surrounded; Wanxiang rode to his relief, was wounded in the right thigh, and returned to Guyuan to recover.

sentences.zh: 進寶為疏請復姓，授定海總兵，調興化。

translations.literal: Jinbao memorialized to request restoration of his surname; Wanxiang was appointed regional commander of Dinghai and transferred to Xinghua.
translations.idiomatic: Jinbao memorialized to restore Wanxiang's original surname. He was appointed regional commander of Dinghai and transferred to Xinghua.

sentences.zh: 台灣定，復調台灣，擢福建陸路提督。

translations.literal: When Taiwan was pacified, he was again transferred to Taiwan and promoted to Fujian land-route provincial commander.
translations.idiomatic: After Taiwan was pacified, he was posted back to Taiwan and promoted to Fujian land-route provincial commander.

sentences.zh: 卒，贈太子少保，諡壯敏。

translations.literal: He died; he was posthumously granted Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and given the posthumous name Zhuangmin.
translations.idiomatic: He died and was posthumously granted Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent with the posthumous name Zhuangmin.

sentences.zh: 孫思克，字藎臣，漢軍正白旗人。

translations.literal: Sun Sike, courtesy name Jinchen, was a Han Bannerman of the Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Sike, courtesy name Jinchen, was a Han Bannerman of the Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 父得功，以明游擊降太祖，有功，附金玉和傳。

translations.literal: His father Defu, a Ming guerrilla commander who surrendered to Taizu, had merit; he is treated in Jin Yuhe's biography.
translations.idiomatic: His father Defu, a Ming guerrilla commander who surrendered to Taizu, distinguished himself; his career is recorded in Jin Yuhe's biography.

sentences.zh: 思克其次子也。

translations.literal: Sike was his second son.
translations.idiomatic: Sike was his second son.

sentences.zh: 初授王府護衛。

translations.literal: At first he was appointed a princely household guard.
translations.idiomatic: He was first appointed a guard in a princely household.

sentences.zh: 順治八年，管牛錄額真，並授刑部理事官。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Shunzhi he administered a niru ejen post and was also appointed a case officer of the Board of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Shunzhi he headed a niru and was also appointed a case officer of the Board of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 十一年，遷甲喇額真。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was transferred to jalan ejen.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he was promoted to jalan ejen.

sentences.zh: 從軍，自湖南下貴州、雲南，轉戰有功。

translations.literal: He followed the army south from Hunan into Guizhou and Yunnan, campaigning with merit.
translations.idiomatic: He took the field, advancing from Hunan into Guizhou and Yunnan, and earned distinction in repeated campaigns.

sentences.zh: 康熙二年，擢甘肅總兵，駐涼州。

translations.literal: In the second year of Kangxi he was promoted to regional commander of Gansu and stationed at Liangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Kangxi he was promoted to regional commander of Gansu and stationed at Liangzhou.

sentences.zh: 五年，厄魯特蒙古徙牧大草灘，慰遣之。

translations.literal: In the fifth year the Oirat Mongols moved their herds to Dacaotan; he comforted and sent them away.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year Oirat Mongols moved their herds to Dacaotan; he reassured them and urged them to withdraw.

sentences.zh: 不受命，戰於定羌廟，敗去，揚言將分道入邊為寇。

translations.literal: They did not accept orders; he fought them at Dingqiang Temple and they were defeated and withdrew, proclaiming that they would enter the frontier by separate routes as raiders.
translations.idiomatic: They refused to obey. He fought them at Dingqiang Temple and drove them off; they then threatened to raid the frontier by several routes.

sentences.zh: 思克與提督張勇疏請用兵，廷議不可輕啟兵釁，令嚴防邊境，撫卹番人。

translations.literal: Sike and Provincial Commander Zhang Yong jointly memorialized requesting military action; court deliberation held that war must not be lightly provoked, and ordered strict frontier defense and pacification of the tribes.
translations.idiomatic: Sike and provincial commander Zhang Yong memorialized for military action, but the court ruled against provoking war and ordered strict frontier defense and conciliation of the tribes.

sentences.zh: 思克乃偕勇修築邊牆，首扁都口西水關，至嘉峪關止，於是厄魯特蒙古入邊牧者皆徙走。

translations.literal: Sike then joined Yong in repairing the frontier wall from Biandukou and Xishuiguan westward to Jiayuguan; thereupon all Oirat Mongols pasturing inside the border moved away.
translations.idiomatic: Sike then joined Yong in building the frontier wall from Biandukou and Xishuiguan west to Jiayuguan, after which Oirat Mongols grazing inside the border all withdrew.

sentences.zh: 思克遍視南山諸險隘，分兵固禦，乃益敕軍紀，簡將才，汰冗卒，覈餉糈，剔蠹蝕，戢兵安民，疆圉敉寧。

translations.literal: Sike inspected all the dangerous passes of the southern mountains, divided troops to secure them, then further enforced military discipline, selected commanders of talent, eliminated redundant soldiers, audited rations, cut out corruption, restrained the troops and settled the people, and the frontier was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Sike inspected the southern mountain passes and posted troops to hold them. He tightened discipline, picked able officers, cut redundant troops, audited supplies, rooted out corruption, kept the army in check and reassured the people, and the frontier was quieted.

sentences.zh: 總督盧崇峻以聞，加右都督。

translations.literal: Governor-General Lu Chongjun reported this, and Sike was advanced to Right Commissioner-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-general Lu Chongjun reported his achievements, and Sike was promoted to Right Commissioner-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 十三年，提督王輔臣以平涼叛應吳三桂，臨洮、鞏昌皆附，蘭州亦陷。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year Provincial Commander Wang Fuchen rebelled at Pingliang in support of Wu Sangui; Lintao and Gongchang all joined him, and Lanzhou also fell.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year provincial commander Wang Fuchen rebelled at Pingliang for Wu Sangui; Lintao and Gongchang went over to him, and Lanzhou fell as well.

sentences.zh: 總督哈占檄思克赴援，思克率師道阿壩紅水蘆塘至索橋，結筏渡河，克靖遠，附近諸城堡悉下。

translations.literal: Governor-General Hazhan ordered Sike to the relief; Sike led his army by way of Aba, Hongshui, Lutang, and Suoqiao, built rafts to cross the river, took Jingyuan, and all nearby forts were captured.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-general Hazhan ordered Sike to the relief. Sike marched through Aba, Hongshui, and Lutang to Suoqiao, rafted the river, took Jingyuan, and reduced the neighboring forts.

sentences.zh: 厄魯特墨爾根台吉乘隙毀隘，入為寇，副將陳達陣沒。

translations.literal: The Oirat Mo'ergen Taiji seized the opening to destroy passes and entered as raiders; Deputy Commander Chen Da fell in battle.
translations.idiomatic: The Oirat Mo'ergen Taiji seized the chance to destroy passes and raid the border; deputy commander Chen Da was killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 思克乃留參將劉選勝等守靖遠，率師還涼州，墨爾根台吉引去。

translations.literal: Sike then left Brigade Commander Liu Xuansheng and others to hold Jingyuan, led his army back to Liangzhou, and Mo'ergen Taiji withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Sike left brigade commander Liu Xuansheng and others to hold Jingyuan and marched back to Liangzhou; Mo'ergen Taiji then withdrew.

sentences.zh: 高台黃番復入邊為寇，攻圍暖泉、順德諸堡。

translations.literal: The Huangfan of Gaotai again entered the border as raiders and attacked and besieged the forts of Nuanquan, Shunde, and others.
translations.idiomatic: The Huangfan of Gaotai again raided the frontier and besieged Nuanquan, Shunde, and other forts.

sentences.zh: 思克率師赴甘州，黃番亦遠遁，乃復渡河而東，與勇會師。

translations.literal: Sike led his army to Ganzhou; the Huangfan also fled far away; he then crossed the river again eastward and joined forces with Yong.
translations.idiomatic: Sike marched to Ganzhou and the Huangfan fled. He then crossed the river again to the east and joined Zhang Yong.

sentences.zh: 疏言所部兵自草地往來勞苦，乞恩加犒賞，上特許之。

translations.literal: He memorialized that the troops under his command, coming and going over the grasslands, had suffered hardship, and begged an imperial bounty; the Emperor specially granted it.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized that his men had suffered hardship marching through the grasslands and asked for an extra reward; the Emperor granted it.

sentences.zh: 思克會勇圍鞏昌，時大將軍貝勒洞鄂攻秦州未下，三桂遣兵自四川至，營南山上，勢方張。

translations.literal: Sike joined Yong in besieging Gongchang; at the time Grand General Prince Dong'e attacked Qinzhou without success; Sangui sent troops from Sichuan, encamped on South Mountain, and their momentum was just rising.
translations.idiomatic: Sike joined Yong in besieging Gongchang. Grand General Prince Dong'e was still unable to take Qinzhou; Wu Sangui sent troops from Sichuan to camp on South Mountain, and rebel strength was growing.

sentences.zh: 檄思克率二千人自鞏昌赴援，壁州西，與相持。

translations.literal: An order reached Sike to lead two thousand men from Gongchang to the relief; he encamped west of Bizhou and faced them in stalemate.
translations.idiomatic: Sike was ordered to lead two thousand men from Gongchang to reinforce Qinzhou. He encamped west of Bizhou and held the enemy at bay.

sentences.zh: 輔臣將陳萬策等詣思克降，巴三綱遁走，遂克秦州。

translations.literal: Fuchen's generals Chen Wance and others came to Sike to surrender; Ba Sangang fled, and Qinzhou was then taken.
translations.idiomatic: Fuchen's generals Chen Wance and others surrendered to Sike; Ba Sangang fled, and Qinzhou was taken.

sentences.zh: 南山寇潰竄，思克與將軍佛尼埒等追擊，敗之閻關，復禮縣；

translations.literal: The bandits on South Mountain broke and fled; Sike with General Fonile and others pursued, defeated them at Yanguan, and recovered Li County;
translations.idiomatic: The rebels on South Mountain broke and fled. Sike and General Fonile pursued, defeated them at Yanguan, and recovered Li County;

sentences.zh: 复敗之西和，奪門入，斬所置吏，清水、伏羌諸縣皆下。

translations.literal: again defeated them at Xihe, stormed the gate and entered, beheaded the officials they had installed, and Qingshui, Fuqiang, and other counties all submitted.
translations.idiomatic: defeated them again at Xihe, stormed the gates, beheaded the officials they had installed, and Qingshui, Fuqiang, and the other counties all fell.

sentences.zh: 復還軍鞏昌，遣萬策等入城諭輔臣將陳可等，以鞏昌十七州縣降。

translations.literal: He again returned his army to Gongchang, sent Wance and others into the city to instruct Fuchen's generals Chen Ke and the rest, and the seventeen prefectures and counties of Gongchang surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: He marched back to Gongchang and sent Wance and others into the city to win over Fuchen's generals Chen Ke and the rest; the seventeen prefectures and counties of the Gongchang region surrendered.

sentences.zh: 河東悉定。

translations.literal: All east of the river was settled.
translations.idiomatic: The whole region east of the river was pacified.

sentences.zh: 乃會攻平涼，思克率師出靜寧，擊敗輔臣將李國梁，斬級五百，獲裨將三，復其城。

translations.literal: They then joined in the attack on Pingliang; Sike led his army out from Jingning, defeated Fuchen's general Li Guoliang, took five hundred heads, captured three subordinate commanders, and recovered the city.
translations.idiomatic: They then converged on Pingliang. Sike marched from Jingning, defeated Fuchen's general Li Guoliang, took five hundred heads and three subordinate commanders, and recovered the city.

sentences.zh: 進次華亭，輔臣將高鼎率裨將二十八、兵千餘，迎降。

translations.literal: Advancing to Huating, Fuchen's general Gao Ding led twenty-eight subordinate commanders and more than a thousand troops to meet him and surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing to Huating, Fuchen's general Gao Ding came out with twenty-eight subordinate commanders and more than a thousand men to surrender.

sentences.zh: 遂至平涼，與貝勒洞鄂師會。

translations.literal: He then reached Pingliang and joined Prince Dong'e's army.
translations.idiomatic: He then reached Pingliang and joined Prince Dong'e's forces.

sentences.zh: 城兵出戰，思克徒步督所部當賊，戰南山，戰城北，八戰輒勝。

translations.literal: The garrison came out to fight; Sike on foot directed his command to meet the enemy, fighting on South Mountain and north of the city; in eight engagements he always won.
translations.idiomatic: The garrison sallied forth. Sike directed his men on foot on South Mountain and north of the wall; in eight engagements he was victorious every time.

sentences.zh: 又為九覆，敗賊南郭外。

translations.literal: He again laid nine ambushes and defeated the rebels outside the south suburb.
translations.idiomatic: He set nine ambushes and routed the rebels outside the south gate.

sentences.zh: 賊阻我軍掘壕，思克揮兵急擊，賊退复逼者三，皆敗去。

translations.literal: The rebels obstructed our army's digging of trenches; Sike waved his troops to strike urgently; the rebels withdrew and again pressed forward three times, and each time were defeated and driven off.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels tried to stop our troops from digging trenches. Sike led fierce counterattacks; three times they fell back and pressed in again, and each time were beaten off.

sentences.zh: 攻涇州白起寨，揮兵先登，克寨，獲輔臣將李茂。

translations.literal: Attacking Baiqi stockade in Jingzhou, he waved his troops to ascend first, took the stockade, and captured Fuchen's general Li Mao.
translations.idiomatic: Attacking Baiqi stockade in Jingzhou, he led the assault, took the stockade, and captured Fuchen's general Li Mao.

sentences.zh: 又敗之甲子峪，敗之馬營子、麻布嶺，洞鄂上其功。

translations.literal: He again defeated them at Jiazi Valley, defeated them at Mayingzi and Mabuling; Dong'e reported his merit.
translations.idiomatic: He defeated them again at Jiazi Valley and at Mayingzi and Mabuling; Dong'e commended his achievements.

sentences.zh: 十五年，圖海代洞鄂督師，至城北虎山墩度形勢，並偵通固原道。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year Tu Hai replaced Dong'e in command of the army, went to Hushan Mound north of the city to survey the terrain, and also reconnoitered the road through to Guyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year Tu Hai replaced Dong'e as commander, inspected the ground at Hushan Mound north of the city, and reconnoitered the route to Guyuan.

sentences.zh: 賊伏兵萬餘猝起，思克急擊之，逐北十餘里，被巨創。

translations.literal: More than ten thousand rebel ambush troops rose suddenly; Sike struck them urgently, pursued north more than ten li, and received grave wounds.
translations.idiomatic: More than ten thousand rebel ambushers sprang up. Sike counterattacked at once, pursued them more than ten li, and was badly wounded.

sentences.zh: 輔臣乞降，思克還涼州。

translations.literal: Fuchen begged to surrender; Sike returned to Liangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Fuchen sued for surrender, and Sike returned to Liangzhou.

sentences.zh: 詔褒思克功，擢涼州提督，授世職一等阿達哈哈番。

translations.literal: An edict praised Sike's merit; he was promoted to Liangzhou provincial commander and granted the hereditary rank of first-class ada hahafan.
translations.idiomatic: An edict praised Sike's achievements. He was promoted to Liangzhou provincial commander and granted the hereditary rank of first-class ada hahafan.

sentences.zh: 思克疏謝，因言：「虎山墩之戰，賊斫臣右臂，傷筋骨。

translations.literal: Sike memorialized thanks and said: "In the battle at Hushan Mound the rebels hacked my right arm and injured sinew and bone.
translations.idiomatic: Sike memorialized his thanks and said, "At Hushan Mound the rebels hacked my right arm and injured the sinews and bone.

sentences.zh: 今已成殘疾，乞解任回旗。

translations.literal: Now I have become crippled; I beg to be relieved of office and return to the Banner.
translations.idiomatic: I am now crippled and beg to be relieved and return to the Banner.

sentences.zh: 」溫旨慰留。

translations.literal: " A warm edict comforted him and kept him in post.
translations.idiomatic: " A gracious edict comforted him and kept him in office.

sentences.zh: 十六年，敘功，進三等阿思哈尼哈番。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, when merit was reviewed, he was advanced to third-class ashan i hafan.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year his merit was reviewed and he was advanced to third-class ashan i hafan.

sentences.zh: 噶爾丹為亂，諸蒙古徙入邊擾民，思克與勇遣兵驅之，乃去。

translations.literal: Galdan made trouble; various Mongols moved inside the border to harass the people; Sike and Yong sent troops to drive them off, and they then departed.
translations.idiomatic: When Galdan rebelled, Mongols drifted into the borderlands to harass the people; Sike and Yong sent troops to drive them out.

sentences.zh: 十八年，上敕圖海合諸軍下四川，定四道進兵，思克與將軍畢力克圖出略陽。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year the Emperor ordered Tu Hai to unite the armies in descending on Sichuan, fixed four routes of advance, and Sike with General Biliketu marched out from Lueyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year the Emperor ordered Tu Hai to unite the armies for the Sichuan campaign along four routes; Sike and General Biliketu advanced from Lueyang.

sentences.zh: 會京師地震，詔內外大臣陳所見。

translations.literal: It happened that the capital was shaken by earthquake; an edict ordered inner and outer ministers to state their views.
translations.idiomatic: An earthquake struck the capital, and the Emperor ordered ministers at court and in the provinces to submit their views.

sentences.zh: 思克疏言：「漢中、興安山嶺紆險，賊劃斷要隘，師未能直入。

translations.literal: Sike memorialized: "The mountains of Hanzhong and Xing'an are winding and perilous; the rebels have cut the vital passes, and the army cannot advance straight in.
translations.idiomatic: Sike memorialized, "The mountains of Hanzhong and Xing'an are winding and dangerous; the rebels hold the key passes, and our forces cannot advance directly.

sentences.zh: 綠旗兵不盡強壯，馬又多羸瘦，滿洲兵亦無多。

translations.literal: The Green Standard troops are not all strong and sturdy; many horses are lean and weak; Manchu troops are also not numerous.
translations.idiomatic: The Green Standard troops are not all fit, many horses are weak, and Manchu forces are few.

sentences.zh: 若各路調取，又恐地偪番夷，秋高馬肥，乘機思逞。

translations.literal: If troops are drawn from every route, I also fear the land presses close on the tribes; when autumn is high and horses fat, they will seize the chance to show their strength.
translations.idiomatic: If we strip troops from every route, I fear the tribes on our flanks will take advantage when autumn comes and their horses are strong.

sentences.zh: 秦地多山，土不生秔稻，採買麥豆，用民負載馱運，餽運維艱。

translations.literal: Qin territory is mostly mountainous; the soil does not produce rice; wheat and beans are purchased and carried on people's backs and by pack animals; supply transport is extremely difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Qin is mountainous and grows little rice; we must buy wheat and beans and haul them on men's backs and pack animals, so supply is very hard.

sentences.zh: 諸軍聞京師地震，傾壞房屋，壓斃人口，各有內顧憂。

translations.literal: All the armies heard of the capital earthquake, houses overturned and ruined, people crushed to death, and each had worries of looking homeward.
translations.idiomatic: The troops heard of the capital earthquake, of houses collapsed and people killed, and each man worried for home.

sentences.zh: 不若今秋暫緩出師，選強壯，飼戰馬，俟來春再議進兵。

translations.literal: It would be better this autumn to pause the campaign for the moment, select the strong and sturdy, feed the war horses, and wait until next spring to discuss advancing the army again.
translations.idiomatic: It would be better to pause this autumn, pick the strongest men, rest the horses, and discuss a new advance next spring.

sentences.zh: 」上命學士拉隆禮至涼州宣諭詰責，思克引罪。

translations.literal: " The Emperor ordered Academician Lalongli to Liangzhou to proclaim and rebuke; Sike acknowledged guilt.
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor sent Academician Lalongli to Liangzhou to rebuke him, and Sike confessed his fault.

sentences.zh: 與畢力克圖率師攻階州，進克文成、沔諸縣。

translations.literal: With Biliketu he led troops to attack Jiezhou and advanced to take Wencheng, Mian, and other counties.
translations.idiomatic: With Biliketu he attacked Jiezhou and took Wencheng, Mian, and other counties.

sentences.zh: 上命思克還涼州。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered Sike back to Liangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor ordered Sike back to Liangzhou.

sentences.zh: 尋以總督哈佔奏，移駐莊浪。

translations.literal: Soon, on Governor-General Hazhan's memorial, he was moved to station at Zhuanglang.
translations.idiomatic: Soon, on governor-general Hazhan's recommendation, he was posted to Zhuanglang.

sentences.zh: 二十年，慶陽民耿飛糾番酋達爾嘉濟農等為亂，犯河州，思克與勇遣兵討平之。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year the Qingyang commoner Geng Fei stirred up the tribal chief Darjiajinong and others to rebel, invaded Hezhou, and Sike with Yong sent troops to suppress and pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year the Qingyang commoner Geng Fei stirred up the tribal chief Darjiajinong and others to rebel and attack Hezhou; Sike and Yong sent troops and put the rising down.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，追論請緩師罪，罷提督，奪世職，仍留總兵。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, reviewing the offense of requesting delay of the army, he was dismissed as provincial commander, deprived of his hereditary rank, yet retained as regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year he was punished for urging delay of the campaign: dismissed as provincial commander and stripped of his hereditary rank, but kept on as regional commander.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，复授甘肅提督。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year he was again appointed Gansu provincial commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year he was again appointed Gansu provincial commander.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，學士達瑚、郎中桑格使西域歸，至嘉峪關外，為西海阿奇羅卜藏所劫。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year Academician Dahu and Director Sangge, returning from an embassy to the Western Regions, reached the area outside Jiayuguan and were robbed by the Xihai chief Aqiluobuzang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year Academician Dahu and Director Sangge, returning from the Western Regions, were robbed outside Jiayuguan by the Xihai chief Aqiluobuzang.

sentences.zh: 思克遣游擊硃應祥誘質其宰桑，達瑚等乃得返。

translations.literal: Sike sent Guerrilla Commander Zhu Yingxiang to lure and take hostage their zaisang; Dahu and the rest were then able to return.
translations.idiomatic: Sike sent guerrilla commander Zhu Yingxiang to seize a zaisang hostage; Dahu and his party were then able to return.

sentences.zh: 又遣副將潘育龍、游擊韓成率師討之，斬四百餘級，阿奇羅卜藏敗走。

translations.literal: He again sent Deputy Commander Pan Yulong and Guerrilla Commander Han Cheng to lead troops against them, beheaded more than four hundred, and Aqiluobuzang was defeated and fled.
translations.idiomatic: He then sent deputy commander Pan Yulong and guerrilla commander Han Cheng against them; they took more than four hundred heads and Aqiluobuzang fled in defeat.

sentences.zh: 復使詰責西海諸台吉，諸台吉懼，籍阿奇羅卜藏家償所掠。

translations.literal: He again sent envoys to rebuke the Xihai taiji; the taiji were afraid and registered Aqiluobuzang's household to repay what had been plundered.
translations.idiomatic: He sent envoys to rebuke the Xihai taiji; frightened, they seized Aqiluobuzang's property to make restitution.

sentences.zh: 思克疏請免窮治，上嘉思克籌畫合宜，如其請。

translations.literal: Sike memorialized asking to exempt further prosecution; the Emperor praised Sike's planning as fitting and granted his request.
translations.idiomatic: Sike asked that no further prosecution be pursued; the Emperor praised his judgment and granted the request.

sentences.zh: 三十年，疏言：「噶爾丹巢穴距邊三十餘程，其從子策妄阿喇布坦在西套住牧。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year he memorialized: "Galdan's lair is more than thirty stages from the border; his nephew Tsewang Rabtan pastures in the western banners.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year he memorialized, "Galdan's base lies more than thirty stages from the border; his nephew Tsewang Rabtan pastures in the western banners.

sentences.zh: 雖叔侄為仇，慮其復合，侵掠西海，道必經嘉峪關外。

translations.literal: Although uncle and nephew are at enmity, I fear they may reunite, raid the Xihai, and the road must pass outside Jiayuguan.
translations.idiomatic: Though uncle and nephew are enemies, I fear they may reunite and raid the Xihai by a route that must pass outside Jiayuguan.

sentences.zh: 今設副將，威望未尊，兵不盈千，不足資控禦。

translations.literal: At present a deputy commander is posted, but his prestige is not yet exalted and his troops number less than a thousand, insufficient to support control and defense.
translations.idiomatic: A deputy commander is posted there now, but his standing is low and he has fewer than a thousand men, too few to hold the line.

sentences.zh: 請設總兵一、兵三千，以固邊圉。

translations.literal: I request one regional commander and three thousand troops to secure the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: I ask for one regional commander and three thousand troops to strengthen the frontier.

sentences.zh: 甘肅地瘠民貧，布種收穫，與腹地迥別。

translations.literal: Gansu land is lean and the people poor; sowing cloth-seed and harvest differ greatly from the interior.
translations.idiomatic: Gansu is poor and thinly productive; planting and harvest differ greatly from the interior.

sentences.zh: 縱遇豐年，輸將國賦，僅贍八口，並無蓋藏。

translations.literal: Even in a bumper year, paying state levies barely supports eight mouths, and there is no stored surplus.
translations.idiomatic: Even in a good year, after paying taxes a household can barely feed eight mouths and has nothing laid by.

sentences.zh: 兵馬糧料，不敷供支。

translations.literal: Rations for troops and horses are insufficient for supply.
translations.idiomatic: Provisions for troops and horses fall short.

sentences.zh: 宜於河西要地，屯積糧草。

translations.literal: It is fitting to store up grain and fodder at vital points in Hexi.
translations.idiomatic: Grain and fodder should be stockpiled at key points in Hexi.

sentences.zh: 本地無糧可買，輓運又恐勞民。

translations.literal: Locally there is no grain to buy, and cart transport again fears exhausting the people.
translations.idiomatic: There is little grain to buy locally, and hauling supplies in would overburden the people.

sentences.zh: 請開事例，捐納加級、紀錄、職監。

translations.literal: I request opening a sale of offices by contribution, for promotion in rank, record of merit, and supervision posts.
translations.idiomatic: I ask to open contributions for office sales, promotions, merit records, and supervisory posts.

sentences.zh: 俟邊儲稍充，即行停止。

translations.literal: When frontier stores are somewhat filled, it should at once be stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Once frontier stores are replenished, the scheme should be stopped.

sentences.zh: 」三十一年，加太子少保，予世職拜他喇布勒哈番。

translations.literal: " In the thirty-first year he was advanced to Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and granted the hereditary rank of baitalaburu hafan.
translations.idiomatic: " In the thirty-first year he was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and granted the hereditary rank of baitalaburu hafan.

sentences.zh: 疏乞休，复慰留。

translations.literal: He memorialized begging to retire; again a comforting edict kept him in post.
translations.idiomatic: He asked to retire; again the Emperor comforted him and kept him in office.

sentences.zh: 加振武將軍。

translations.literal: He was advanced to Zhenwu General.
translations.idiomatic: He was made Zhenwu General.

sentences.zh: 三十二年，噶爾丹為亂，命內大臣郎岱率禁旅出駐寧夏，以思克為參贊。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year Galdan made trouble; the Emperor ordered Inner Minister Langdai to lead the Forbidden Brigade out to garrison Ningxia, with Sike as coordinator.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-second year, when Galdan rebelled, the Emperor ordered Inner Minister Langdai to lead the Forbidden Brigade to Ningxia, with Sike as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 三十五年，上親征，大將軍費揚古當西路，思克率師出寧夏，與會於翁金。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fifth year the Emperor campaigned in person; Grand General Fei Yanggu held the western route; Sike led his army out from Ningxia and joined him at Wengjin.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fifth year the Emperor campaigned in person. Grand General Fei Yanggu commanded the western route; Sike marched from Ningxia and joined him at Wengjin.

sentences.zh: 上駐蹕克魯倫河，噶爾丹遁去，費揚古督兵邀擊，戰於昭莫多。

translations.literal: The Emperor halted at the Kerulen River; Galdan fled away; Fei Yanggu directed troops to intercept; they fought at Jao Modo.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor halted on the Kerulen. Galdan fled; Fei Yanggu moved to intercept and fought at Jao Modo.

sentences.zh: 思克將綠旗兵居中，與諸軍並力奮戰，大破之，逐北三十餘里，噶爾丹引數騎走。

translations.literal: Sike led the Green Standard troops in the center; with the various armies he joined strength and fought fiercely, inflicting a great defeat, pursuing north more than thirty li; Galdan led off a few horsemen and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Sike led the Green Standard troops in the center; all the armies fought together and routed the enemy, pursuing them more than thirty li as Galdan fled with only a few horsemen.

sentences.zh: 詔褒諭，召詣京師，命侍衛迎勞，御製詩，書箑以賜。

translations.literal: An edict praised and instructed him; he was summoned to the capital; guards were ordered to welcome and comfort him; the Emperor composed a poem and wrote it on a fan to bestow.
translations.idiomatic: An edict praised him and summoned him to the capital. Guards were sent to welcome him; the Emperor composed a poem and wrote it on a fan as a gift.

sentences.zh: 入對暢春園，賜綏懷堂額及端罩、四團龍補服、孔雀翎、衣冠、鞍馬，並賚從入京師官兵糧料。

translations.literal: He entered audience at the Garden of Exuberant Spring; he was granted the hall name Suihuai Tang and a formal surcoat, four-dragon rank patch, peacock feather, robes and hat, saddle and horse, and rations were also bestowed on the officers and troops who followed him into the capital.
translations.idiomatic: He was received at the Garden of Exuberant Spring and given the hall name Suihuai Tang, a formal surcoat, four-dragon rank insignia, a peacock feather, robes, hat, saddle, and horse; rations were also granted to the officers and men who had accompanied him to the capital.

sentences.zh: 命駐肅州，诇噶爾丹踪跡。

translations.literal: He was ordered to garrison at Suzhou and spy out Galdan's tracks.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to garrison at Suzhou and track Galdan's movements.

sentences.zh: 三十七年，敘功，加拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: In the thirty-seventh year, when merit was reviewed, he was advanced to tosoro hafan.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-seventh year his merit was reviewed and he was advanced to tosoro hafan.

sentences.zh: 三十九年，以病乞休，遣醫往視，仍命留任養疴。

translations.literal: In the thirty-ninth year, ill, he begged to retire; a physician was sent to attend him, yet he was still ordered to remain in office and nurse his illness.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-ninth year he asked to retire on grounds of illness; a physician was sent to attend him, but he was ordered to remain in office and convalesce.

sentences.zh: 尋卒，贈太子太保，賜祭葬，諡襄武。

translations.literal: Soon after he died; he was posthumously made Grand Tutor to the Heir Apparent, granted the rites of sacrifice and burial, and given the posthumous title Xiangwu.
translations.idiomatic: He died soon after. He was posthumously made Grand Tutor to the Heir Apparent, granted state funeral honors, and given the posthumous title Xiangwu.

sentences.zh: 喪還京師，命皇長子允禔臨奠。

translations.literal: When the coffin returned to the capital, the emperor ordered the eldest imperial son Yin Zhi to attend the obsequies.
translations.idiomatic: When his remains were brought to the capital, the emperor ordered the eldest imperial son Yin Zhi to preside at the funeral rites.

sentences.zh: 思克鎮邊久，威惠孚洽。

translations.literal: Sike had long garrisoned the frontier, and his authority and kindness won universal trust.
translations.idiomatic: Sike had long commanded the frontier, where his authority and kindness won universal trust.

sentences.zh: 喪還自甘州，至潼關，凡道所經，軍民號泣相送。

translations.literal: As the coffin returned from Ganzhou to Tongguan, along every stretch of the road soldiers and civilians wept aloud in farewell.
translations.idiomatic: As his coffin was borne from Ganzhou to Tongguan, soldiers and civilians along the entire route wept aloud in farewell.

sentences.zh: 上聞狀，歎曰：「使思克平昔居官不善，何以得此？

translations.literal: When the emperor heard the report, he sighed and said: "If Sike had not governed well in ordinary times, how could he have won this?"
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor heard this, he sighed and said, "If Sike had not governed well in ordinary times, how could he have won such devotion?"

sentences.zh: 」進世職一等阿思哈尼哈番兼拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: His hereditary rank was advanced to first-class ashan i haqan, concurrently toshala haqan.
translations.idiomatic: His descendants' hereditary rank was advanced to first-class ashan i haqan with the additional grant of toshala haqan.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四年，定封一等男。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Qianlong he was fixed in rank as a first-class baron.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Qianlong the family was fixed in rank as first-class baron.

sentences.zh: 三十二年，命世襲罔替。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year he was ordered to pass down the title in perpetual inheritance.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-second year perpetual inheritance of the title was granted.

sentences.zh: 曾孫慶成，自有傳。

translations.literal: His great-grandson Qingcheng has his own biography.
translations.idiomatic: His great-grandson Qingcheng has a separate biography.

sentences.zh: 馬進良，甘肅西寧人。

translations.literal: Ma Jinliang was a native of Xining in Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Jinliang came from Xining in Gansu.

sentences.zh: 初入伍，隸思克軍。

translations.literal: He first entered the ranks and was placed under Sike's army.
translations.idiomatic: He first enlisted and served under Sike.

sentences.zh: 從攻平涼，輔臣拒戰，賊斫思克手。

translations.literal: Following the attack on Pingliang, Fuchen resisted in battle, and the bandits cut Sike's hand.
translations.idiomatic: During the assault on Pingliang, Fuchen fought back, and a rebel blade cut Sike's hand.

sentences.zh: 進良聞之，曰：「斫我總兵手，我必殺之！

translations.literal: When Jinliang heard this, he said: "He cut my regional commander's hand — I shall kill him!"
translations.idiomatic: When Jinliang heard this, he cried, "He struck my commander — I will kill him!"

sentences.zh: 」乃入賊陣，逐斫思克手者殺之，身被數創。

translations.literal: He then entered the enemy formation, pursued the man who had cut Sike's hand, and killed him, himself receiving several wounds.
translations.idiomatic: He charged into the enemy ranks, hunted down the man who had struck Sike, and killed him, though he himself took several wounds.

sentences.zh: 敘功，累遷游擊。

translations.literal: When merit was reviewed, he was promoted in succession to guerrilla commander.
translations.idiomatic: His services were recognized and he rose in succession to guerrilla commander.

sentences.zh: 思克請補中軍參將，格部議，上特允之。

translations.literal: Sike requested that he be appointed brigade commander of the central army; the ministry deliberation blocked it, but the emperor specially approved.
translations.idiomatic: Sike asked that he be made brigade commander of the central army. The ministry objected, but the emperor personally approved.

sentences.zh: 复再遷，授古北口總兵。

translations.literal: He was again promoted and appointed regional commander of Gubeikou.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted again and appointed regional commander of Gubeikou.

sentences.zh: 上徵噶爾丹，命將千五百人從。

translations.literal: When the emperor campaigned against Galdan, he was ordered to lead fifteen hundred men in attendance.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor campaigned against Galdan, he was ordered to bring fifteen hundred men.

sentences.zh: 擢直隸提督，諭獎飭營伍，訓練嚴明。

translations.literal: He was promoted to provincial commander of Zhili; an edict praised him for disciplining his camps and training them with strict clarity.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to provincial commander of Zhili. An edict praised him for keeping his camps in order and training them with exemplary discipline.

sentences.zh: 中軍參將缺，上特授其子龍。

translations.literal: When the post of brigade commander of the central army fell vacant, the emperor specially appointed his son Long.
translations.idiomatic: When the brigade commander's post fell vacant, the emperor specially appointed his son Long.

sentences.zh: 尋以老乞休。

translations.literal: Soon after, on grounds of age he begged to retire.
translations.idiomatic: He soon asked to retire on account of age.

sentences.zh: 卒，賜祭葬，諡襄毅。

translations.literal: When he died he was granted the rites of sacrifice and burial and given the posthumous title Xiangyi.
translations.idiomatic: At his death he was granted state funeral honors and the posthumous title Xiangyi.

sentences.zh: 論曰：世稱河西四將，以勇為冠，忠勇篤誠，識拔裨佐，同時至專閫，奉指揮維謹。

translations.literal: The commentator says: The age called them the four generals of Hexi, with Yong foremost — loyal, brave, and sincere, discerning and promoting subordinates; they rose together to independent command and obeyed orders with scrupulous care.
translations.idiomatic: The historian remarks: The age called them the four generals of Hexi, with Yong foremost — loyal, brave, and sincere, skilled at raising subordinates from the ranks. They rose together to independent command and obeyed orders with scrupulous care.

sentences.zh: 高宗許為古名將，允哉！

translations.literal: The Gaozong emperor acknowledged them as generals in the mold of antiquity — rightly so!
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Gaozong acknowledged them as generals in the mold of antiquity — and rightly so.

sentences.zh: 良棟、進寶，轉戰定四川，進寶實首功，乃忼爽多所忤，聖祖力全之，始以功名終。

translations.literal: Liangdong and Jinbao fought through many battles to pacify Sichuan; Jinbao in truth bore the chief merit, yet he was bold and open and often gave offense; the Sacred Ancestor exerted himself to preserve him, and he was able to end his life in honor.
translations.idiomatic: Liangdong and Jinbao fought through Sichuan to its pacification. Jinbao in truth bore the chief merit, yet he was forthright and often gave offense. The Kangxi emperor exerted himself to preserve him, and he was able to end his career in honor.

sentences.zh: 進寶亦與良棟齟齬，不令並下雲南，怏怏稱疾，命其子代將。

translations.literal: Jinbao also clashed with Liangdong; he was not allowed to march into Yunnan together with him, took offense and pleaded illness, and had his son take command in his stead.
translations.idiomatic: Jinbao also clashed with Liangdong. Not permitted to march into Yunnan alongside him, he took offense, pleaded illness, and had his son take command in his place.

sentences.zh: 思克請緩師，雖不得與良棟、進寶同功，仍俾坐鎮，皆聖祖馭將之略也。

translations.literal: Sike requested that the army advance slowly; though he could not share merit with Liangdong and Jinbao on equal terms, he was still left to hold command — all part of the Sacred Ancestor's art of controlling generals.
translations.idiomatic: Sike urged delaying the advance. Though he could not share equal glory with Liangdong and Jinbao, he was still left in command — all part of the Kangxi emperor's art of managing his generals.

sentences.zh: 思克戰功微不逮，而惓惓愛民，可謂知本矣。

translations.literal: Sike's battle achievements were somewhat less, yet he cared earnestly for the people — this may be called knowing what is fundamental.
translations.idiomatic: Sike's battlefield achievements were somewhat less, yet he cared earnestly for the people — in that he knew what truly mattered.
